notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR v 2.01: Bug fix
notes.notes:
Happy new year !

A quick update for the bug that was preventing the perfect clear animation to show up.

Also, due to popular demand, v1.1 has now been made available on beta.
You can select it by opening the steam game property and selecting v1.1 in the beta tab. Please be aware that version 1.1 is "as is" and will not change anymore. To return to the most recent version, just select "default" on the beta tab.

Cheers and happy dancing.

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR v2.0: Major gameplay update
notes.notes:
Today we're happy to bring you a big update to Hatsune Miku VR:

Changes
- Gameplay Update
Notes will now come closer to you, letting you pick them up in front of you instead of having to extend your arms to the sides, to better accommodate different players and hardware.

- 8 Speakers
Four new speakers have been added as sources of notes, making for more variation. And in hard modes the speakers start to move...

- Sound Effect ON/OFF option
Due to popular demand, there is now an option letting you turn off the sound when you pick up or miss a note.

- Updated Menu
Improved menu legibility by using a larger font.

Due to these changes, the leaderboards have also been reset.
